author: Sophia
title: What is new in the new trailer GTA 6
text:
Last week, Rockstar turned upside down GTA fans, officially announcing that GTA 6 will not be released in 2025-The blockbuster release must be postponed until May 2026. But almost after that, the developers again light up an exaggeration around the game, publishing a new introduction. PC Gamer portal talks about the main details that can be seen in the video.
The melody of the game will be more mundane If you distract a little from optical graphics and look closer to what is happening on the screen, then GTA 6 looks a bit more secular than the unreasonable part of the fifth part. Obviously, the game will also have spectacular scenes and staging moments, but it seems that the plot opens mainly in the low betting world and street criminals.
Reference to data leak 2022 The trailer began with a joke Caustic: on the roof, Jason shouted that “repair leaked”. In the context, in 2022, developers were hacked, because there were many details of the game that was not published-a hacker living in the UK, arrested and convicted to stay in the hospital for a lifetime.
Potential role -playing game elements In one of the scenes of the video, Jason exercises with dumbbells, and, if you look closely, his appearance is slightly changed – from tanning to haircut. Because of this, the similarity to mini players from San Andreas is proposed, related to the role -playing systems, associated with the weight and physical shape of the main character. It seems that GTA 6 will return to these ideas.
The return of the old characters So far, this is nothing more than a theory, but one of the characters in a video (a man in a weapon store) is similar to Phila Cassidi. If he really is, then Phil will be the second character (after Lazlo) returns from the original three-dimensional GTA trio (he is in 3, Vice City and Spin-offs for PSP). At least the name of the store confirms this provision-ignu-nation.
Name of the characters Thanks to the second trailer, we finally know the complete name of the main characters. In Jason prison, it seems like Jason Duval, and Lucia is Kamino. In addition, the video is a few times for their home, obviously, can be pumped when it passes.
Other small details Finally, Rockstar showed many other small things. So, in the trailer, you can notice the virtual version of Metrorail – the rail system on the Miami ground. And cats! Moreover, both large and small: One of the new screenshots on the official website shows a hunt for the alarm to a deer.
